title: comptime evaluation cannot reach the filesystem through an imported host module binding
notes: specification/comptime.mdx, 'Determinism': comptime 'MUST NOT observe ambient ... filesystem state', and 'Comptime I/O': compiler-known imports and embedding are the sanctioned path; 'Arbitrary unavailable runtime I/O MUST NOT be performed merely because a call occurs beneath comptime.' The filesystem has no ambient global in any supported host, so the only spelling that could reach it from a comptime argument is a host-module import — which the evaluator must refuse to evaluate rather than execute.

xfail.reason: the fork reports VIBE1510@1:30 (module-initialization trust on the node:fs import) BESIDE the comptime refusal VCT1004@4:30. The reference's staged acceptance reports the comptime refusal alone, because comptime lowering runs before VibeLang lowering and a comptime refusal short-circuits; the fork does not short-circuit its VibeLang stage on a comptime refusal, so the import-edge cascade leaks through.
xfail.doc: conformance/README.md 'Acceptance is the frontend's own acceptance, in ordered stages': a comptime refusal is reported directly at its authored position; specification/comptime.mdx 'Determinism' is the rule under test.
